name: Database Management Systems
short_description: Relational algebra, SQL, normalization, transactions, concurrency, and indexing.
description: Comprehensive study of relational database models, entity-relationship modeling, formal relational algebra, SQL DDL/DML, normalization forms, transaction ACID properties, and B+ tree storage indexing.

courses.title: Database Management Systems Fundamentals
courses.description: Foundations of relational database design, query optimization, ACID transactions, and index structures.

modules.title: Database Fundamentals
modules.description: File systems limitations, data abstraction levels, and ANSI/SPARC 3-tier architecture.

topics.title: File Systems vs DBMS
topics.summary: Data redundancy, inconsistency, and declarative querying advantages.

topics.title: 3-Schema Architecture
topics.summary: Physical, logical, and external schema separation for data independence.

modules.title: Relational Model
modules.description: Mathematical relations, tuples, domain constraints, and relational algebra.

topics.title: Relational Model & Tuple Algebra
topics.summary: Relations as tables, attribute domains, and selection/projection operators.

modules.title: ER Model
modules.description: Entity-Relationship modeling, cardinalities, weak entity sets, and ER-to-relational mapping.

topics.title: Entity Sets & Cardinality Ratios
topics.summary: 1:1, 1:N, M:N relationship constraints and Crow's foot notation.

topics.title: ER-to-Relational Mapping
topics.summary: Turning entities, relationships, weak entities, and multivalued attributes into tables.

modules.title: Keys & Constraints
modules.description: Candidate keys, primary keys, foreign keys, and referential integrity constraints.

topics.title: Key Types & Integrity Constraints
topics.summary: Superkeys, minimal keys, cascading foreign key delete/update actions.

modules.title: SQL
modules.description: Structured Query Language, DDL, DML, aggregate expressions, and subqueries.

topics.title: Declarative SQL Queries & Filtering
topics.summary: SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING, and aggregate functions.

topics.title: Subqueries, Views & Aggregation
topics.summary: Nested and correlated subqueries, GROUP BY with HAVING, views, and set operations.

modules.title: Joins
modules.description: Relational join algorithms, inner joins, outer joins, and cartesian products.

topics.title: Inner, Outer & Self Joins
topics.summary: Equi-joins, left/right outer joins, and nested loop execution.

modules.title: Normalization
modules.description: Functional dependencies, Armstrong's axioms, 1NF, 2NF, 3NF, and BCNF decomposition.

topics.title: Functional Dependencies & Normal Forms
topics.summary: Lossless-join decomposition, dependency preservation, and 3NF vs BCNF.

modules.title: Transactions
modules.description: Transaction states, ACID guarantees, and serializability.

topics.title: ACID Properties & Transaction States
topics.summary: Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, and Durability enforcement.

modules.title: Concurrency Control
modules.description: Locking protocols, 2-Phase Locking (2PL), deadlock prevention, and timestamp ordering.

topics.title: Schedules & Serializability
topics.summary: Conflict serializability, precedence graphs, and recoverable schedules.

topics.title: Two-Phase Locking (2PL) & Conflicts
topics.summary: Growing and shrinking phases, cascading rollbacks, strict 2PL.

modules.title: Indexing
modules.description: Primary and secondary indexes, dense vs sparse indexes, B+ Trees.

topics.title: B+ Tree Index Structures
topics.summary: Balanced node splitting, leaf pointer chains, and logarithmic search cost.

topics.title: Query Processing & Optimization
topics.summary: How a query becomes a plan: algebraic rewrites, join algorithms, and cost estimates.

modules.title: Recovery
modules.description: Write-Ahead Logging (WAL), undo/redo logging, checkpoints, and ARIES recovery.

topics.title: Write-Ahead Logging & Checkpoints
topics.summary: Crash recovery algorithms and idempotent log processing.

modules.title: NoSQL & Distributed Data
modules.description: Non-relational data models and the trade-offs of distributing data.

topics.title: NoSQL Data Models & the CAP Theorem
topics.summary: Key-value, document, column-family, and graph stores, and consistency trade-offs.
